amendment: P6 coordinate-aware pooling parity, frozen-fold consumption, and conditional Tier-A controls
reason: Pre-outcome code-consistency audit found that the implementation used a fixed 7.5/7.5 token center instead of the verified historical continuous target coordinate, and some stage runners deterministically rebuilt rather than consumed the frozen P8-B folds. P8-F also lacked the preregistered historical Tier-A shuffle/capacity controls. These are correctness/spec-parity fixes made before any real Exploration-8 model outcome was viewed.
